title: Christmas Pudding Trifle
hookLine: British-inspired christmas pudding trifle with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Peel the oranges using a sharp knife, ensuring all the pith is removed. Slice as thinly as possible and arrange over a dinner plate. Sprinkle with the demerara sugar followed by the Grand Marnier and set aside. Incorporate {m52989_1}, {m52989_2}, {m52989_3}, and {m52989_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure orange first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Crumble the Christmas pudding into large pieces and scatter over the bottom of a trifle bowl. Lift the oranges onto the pudding in a layer and pour over any juices. Incorporate {m52989_5}, {m52989_6}, {m52989_7}, {m52989_8}, and {m52989_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat the mascarpone until smooth, then stir in the custard. Spoon the mixture over the top of the oranges. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Lightly whip the cream and spoon over the custard. Sprinkle with the flaked almonds and grated chocolate. You can make this a day in advance if you like, chill until ready to serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
